resources.string: How would you like to use TokenBird?
Choose local mode for an all-in-one experience, or connect to a TokenBird server you already run.
Keep the service and your workspace on this device. No URL or token is needed.
Local mode requires Android 9 or newer on this device. Remote server mode is still available.
Connect to a server on your LAN or the internet. Best for older devices and shared workspaces.
Connection details stay in this app and can be changed later in Settings.
Enter the WebSocket URL and access token supplied by your TokenBird server.
TokenBird is verifying and starting its private on-device service. The first launch can take a little longer.
You can retry or use server mode. The technical details below can help diagnose this device.
Enter a valid ws:// or wss:// WebSocket URL.
Unable to load the server. Check the URL and connection.
No compatible file picker is available on this device.
No app is available to open this link.
